sentences: Once upon a time, there were three little pigs.
They left home to build their own houses.
The first pig was in a hurry.
He built his house with straw.
It took him only one hour.
The second pig built his house with sticks.
The third pig was slow and careful.
He built his house with bricks.
"Your work is too slow," they said.
One evening, a hungry wolf came to the village.
He knocked on the straw house.
"Little pig, little pig, let me come in!"
"No, not by the hair on my chin!"
So the wolf blew the straw house down.
The first pig ran to his brother's house.
